bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for a grant to Thrive Family Recovery Resources.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; THRIVE FAMILY RECOVERY RESOURCES. +]

[+$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Thrive Family Recovery Resources for educating families and the workforce, offering nonbillable family peer services throughout Minnesota, integrating generational trauma work for the family system, and working with parents coming out of incarceration and child protective services to help families heal together. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for a grant to Thrive Family Recovery Resources.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; THRIVE FAMILY RECOVERY RESOURCES.

$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Thrive Family Recovery Resources for educating families and the workforce, offering nonbillable family peer services throughout Minnesota, integrating generational trauma work for the family system, and working with parents coming out of incarceration and child protective services to help families heal together.
additions: $200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Thrive Family Recovery Resources for educating families and the workforce, offering nonbillable family peer services throughout Minnesota, integrating generational trauma work for the family system, and working with parents coming out of incarceration and child protective services to help families heal together.
